open Set Finset

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux1 {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    x ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑(s.image (fun i : ι => Pi.single i (1 : ℝ))) : Set (ι → ℝ)) ↔
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧ ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0 := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hh : x ∈ stdSimplex ℝ ι ∩ {y : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ s → y i = 0} := by
      refine convexHull_min ?_ ((convex_stdSimplex ℝ ι).inter ?_) hx
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        refine ⟨single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ i, ?_⟩
        intro j hj
        simp [show j ≠ i from fun h => hj (h ▸ hi)]
      · intro a ha b hb c d hc hd hcd i hi
        simp [ha i hi, hb i hi]
    exact ⟨hh.1.1, hh.1.2, hh.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1, hxs⟩
    have hs1 : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = 1 := by
      rw [← hx1]
      exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => hxs i hi)
    have hsx : ∑ i ∈ s, x i • Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) = x := by
      ext j
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_apply]
      by_cases hj : j ∈ s <;> simp [hj, hxs j]
    rw [← hsx, ← Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 s _ hs1]
    exact s.centerMass_mem_convexHull (fun i _ => hx0 i) (by rw [hs1]; norm_num)
      (fun i hi => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [DecidableEq E] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (p : ι → E) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (s : Finset ι) (z : E) :
    z ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑(s.image p) : Set E) ↔
      ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0) ∧ (∑ i, x i • p i) = z := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, hwz⟩ := Finset.mem_convexHull'.mp hz
    refine ⟨fun i => if i ∈ s then w (p i) else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      change 0 ≤ if i ∈ s then w (p i) else 0
      split_ifs with hi
      · exact hw0 _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
      · exact le_rfl
    · rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ hij => hp hij)] at hw1
      simpa using hw1
    · intro i hi
      simp [hi]
    · rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ hij => hp hij)] at hwz
      simpa [ite_smul] using hwz
  · rintro ⟨x, hx0, hx1, hxs, hxz⟩
    have hs1 : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = 1 := by
      rw [← hx1]
      exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => hxs i hi)
    have hsz : ∑ i ∈ s, x i • p i = z := by
      rw [← hxz]
      exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => by rw [hxs i hi, zero_smul])
    rw [← hsz, ← Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 s _ hs1]
    exact s.centerMass_mem_convexHull (fun i _ => hx0 i) (by rw [hs1]; norm_num)
      (fun i hi => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux3 {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [DecidableEq E] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (p : ι → E) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : (s.image p) → E))
    (x y : ι → ℝ) (hx1 : ∑ i, x i = 1) (hy1 : ∑ i, y i = 1)
    (hxs : ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0) (hys : ∀ i, i ∉ s → y i = 0)
    (hxy : ∑ i, x i • p i = ∑ i, y i • p i) : x = y := by
  classical
  have hs' : AffineIndependent ℝ (fun i : s => p i) :=
    hs.comp_embedding (⟨fun i : s => ⟨p i, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ i.2⟩,
      fun i j h => Subtype.ext (hp (congrArg Subtype.val h))⟩ : s ↪ (s.image p))
  have hx1' : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = 1 :=
    (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => hxs i hi)).trans hx1
  have hy1' : ∑ i ∈ s, y i = 1 :=
    (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => hys i hi)).trans hy1
  have hxy' : ∑ i ∈ s, x i • p i = ∑ i ∈ s, y i • p i := by
    have hx : ∑ i ∈ s, x i • p i = ∑ i, x i • p i :=
      Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => by rw [hxs i hi, zero_smul])
    have hy : ∑ i ∈ s, y i • p i = ∑ i, y i • p i :=
      Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => by rw [hys i hi, zero_smul])
    rw [hx, hy, hxy]
  rw [← Finset.sum_attach] at hx1' hy1' hxy'
  rw [← Finset.sum_attach s (fun i => y i • p i)] at hxy'
  have hh := hs'.eq_of_sum_eq_sum (s := Finset.univ) (hx1'.trans hy1'.symm) hxy'
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s
  · exact hh ⟨i, hi⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · rw [hxs i hi, hys i hi]

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux4 {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [DecidableEq E] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ E)
    (p : ι → E) (hp : Function.Injective p) (s t : Finset ι)
    (hs : s.image p ∈ K.faces) (ht : t.image p ∈ K.faces)
    (x y : ι → ℝ) (hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hx1 : ∑ i, x i = 1) (hy1 : ∑ i, y i = 1)
    (hxs : ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0) (hyt : ∀ i, i ∉ t → y i = 0)
    (hxy : ∑ i, x i • p i = ∑ i, y i • p i) : x = y := by
  classical
  have hx := (x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 p hp s _).2 ⟨x, hx0, hx1, hxs, rfl⟩
  have hy := (x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 p hp t _).2 ⟨y, hy0, hy1, hyt, rfl⟩
  have hmid : (∑ i, x i • p i) ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑((s ∩ t).image p) : Set E) := by
    rw [Finset.image_inter s t hp, Finset.coe_inter]
    exact K.inter_subset_convexHull hs ht ⟨hx, hxy.symm ▸ hy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1, hzs, hzx⟩ := (x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 p hp (s ∩ t) _).1 hmid
  have hxz : x = z := x2611_15358_thmA_aux3 p hp s (K.indep hs) x z hx1 hz1 hxs
    (fun i hi => hzs i (fun h => hi (Finset.mem_inter.mp h).1)) hzx.symm
  have hyz : y = z := x2611_15358_thmA_aux3 p hp t (K.indep ht) y z hy1 hz1 hyt
    (fun i hi => hzs i (fun h => hi (Finset.mem_inter.mp h).2)) (hxy.symm.trans hzx.symm)
  exact hxz.trans hyz.symm

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux5 {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (C : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) :
    IsCompact {x : ι → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} := by
  classical
  have heq : {x : ι → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} =
      stdSimplex ℝ ι ∩ ⋃ s ∈ C.faces, {x : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, stdSimplex]
    tauto
  rw [heq]
  refine (isCompact_stdSimplex ℝ ι).inter_right ?_
  apply C.faces.toFinite.isClosed_biUnion
  intro s hs
  have heq' : {x : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} =
      ⋂ (i : ι) (_ : i ∉ s), {x : ι → ℝ | x i = 0} := by ext x; simp
  rw [heq']
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_iInter fun _ =>
    isClosed_eq (continuous_apply i) continuous_const

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux6 {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [DecidableEq E] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (C : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ E)
    (p : ι → E) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (hfaces : K.faces = (fun s : Finset ι => s.image p) '' C.faces) :
    Nonempty ({x : ι → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} ≃ₜ K.space) := by
  classical
  let R : Set (ι → ℝ) := {x | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0}
  let f : R → K.space := fun x => ⟨∑ i, x.1 i • p i, by
    obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, s, hs, hxs⟩ := x.2
    have hs' : s.image p ∈ K.faces := by rw [hfaces]; exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact K.convexHull_subset_space hs'
      ((x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 p hp s _).2 ⟨x.1, hx0, hx1, hxs, rfl⟩)⟩
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    change Continuous (fun x : R => ∑ i, x.1 i • p i)
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
      ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_subtype_val).smul continuous_const)
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, s, hs, hxs⟩ := x.2
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, t, ht, hyt⟩ := y.2
    have hs' : s.image p ∈ K.faces := by rw [hfaces]; exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    have ht' : t.image p ∈ K.faces := by rw [hfaces]; exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact x2611_15358_thmA_aux4 K p hp s t hs' ht' x.1 y.1
      hx0 hy0 hx1 hy1 hxs hyt (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ := Geometry.SimplicialComplex.mem_space_iff.mp z.2
    rw [hfaces] at ht
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := ht
    obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1, hxs, hxz⟩ := (x2611_15358_thmA_aux2 p hp s _).1 hzt
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx0, hx1, s, hs, hxs⟩, Subtype.ext hxz⟩
  letI : CompactSpace R := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (x2611_15358_thmA_aux5 C)
  exact ⟨Continuous.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩) hcont⟩

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux7 (n : ℕ) (Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (C : AbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n))
    (hC : Nonempty ({x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} ≃ₜ Y)) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)),
      K.vertices.Finite ∧ Nat.card K.vertices = n ∧ Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ Y) := by
  classical
  let p : Fin n → (Fin n → ℝ) := fun i => Pi.single i 1
  have hp_aff : AffineIndependent ℝ p := (Pi.linearIndependent_single_one (Fin n) ℝ).affineIndependent
  have hp : Function.Injective p := hp_aff.injective
  let P := C.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map p
  have hP : AffineIndependent ℝ
      (Subtype.val : (⋃ s ∈ P.faces, (s : Set (Fin n → ℝ))) → (Fin n → ℝ)) := by
    refine hp_aff.range.mono ?_
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    exact Set.mem_range_self i
  let K := Geometry.SimplicialComplex.ofAffineIndependent P hP
  have hv : K.vertices = Set.range p := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := hz
      change s.image p = {z} at heq
      have hmem : z ∈ s.image p := by rw [heq]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
      exact Set.mem_range_self i
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨{i}, C.singleton_mem i, Finset.image_singleton p i⟩
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := x2611_15358_thmA_aux6 C.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex K p hp rfl
  obtain ⟨hC⟩ := hC
  refine ⟨n, K, ?_, ?_, ⟨g.symm.trans hC⟩⟩
  · rw [hv]
    exact Set.finite_range p
  · rw [hv]
    simpa using (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofInjective p hp)).symm

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux8 (n d : ℕ) (Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hfin : K.vertices.Finite) (hcard : Nat.card K.vertices = n)
    (hK : Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ Y)) :
    ∃ C : AbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n),
      Nonempty ({x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
        ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} ≃ₜ Y) := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype K.vertices := hfin.fintype
  let e : Fin n ≃ K.vertices := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq
    (show Fintype.card K.vertices = n by rwa [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card])).symm
  let p : Fin n → (Fin d → ℝ) := fun i => (e i).1
  have hp : Function.Injective p := Subtype.val_injective.comp e.injective
  let C : AbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n) :=
    { faces := {s | s.image p ∈ K.faces}
      isRelLowerSet_faces := by
        intro s hs
        exact ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mp (K.nonempty_of_mem_faces hs),
          fun t hts ht => K.down_closed hs (Finset.image_subset_image hts)
            (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr ht)⟩
      singleton_mem := by
        intro i
        change (Finset.image p ({i} : Finset (Fin n))) ∈ K.faces
        rw [Finset.image_singleton]
        exact (e i).2 }
  have hfaces : K.faces = (fun s : Finset (Fin n) => s.image p) '' C.faces := by
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i ∈ t)
      have himage : s.image p = t := by
        ext z
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
          exact hi
        · intro hz
          have hv : z ∈ K.vertices := K.down_closed ht
            (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hz) (Finset.singleton_nonempty z)
          let v : K.vertices := ⟨z, hv⟩
          refine ⟨e.symm v, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [p, v] using hz
          · simp [p, v]
      refine ⟨s, ?_, himage⟩
      change s.image p ∈ K.faces
      rw [himage]
      exact ht
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact hs
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := x2611_15358_thmA_aux6 C.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex K p hp hfaces
  obtain ⟨hK⟩ := hK
  exact ⟨C, ⟨g.trans hK⟩⟩

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux9 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ E)
    (h : K.vertices.Subsingleton) : K.space.Subsingleton := by
  have hsub : K.space ⊆ K.vertices := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hx⟩ := Geometry.SimplicialComplex.mem_space_iff.mp hx
    apply convexHull_min (t := K.vertices) ?_ h.convex hx
    intro y hy
    exact K.down_closed hs (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hy)
      (Finset.singleton_nonempty y)
  intro x hx y hy
  exact h (hsub hx) (hsub hy)

theorem x2611_15358_thmA_aux10 {E Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nontrivial Y]
    (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ E) (hfin : K.vertices.Finite)
    (hK : Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ Y)) : 2 ≤ Nat.card K.vertices := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype K.vertices := hfin.fintype
  by_contra h
  have hc : Fintype.card K.vertices ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    omega
  letI : Subsingleton K.vertices := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mp hc
  have hs : K.vertices.Subsingleton := by
    intro x hx y hy
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨x, hx⟩ : K.vertices) ⟨y, hy⟩)
  have hspace := x2611_15358_thmA_aux9 K hs
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hK
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne Y
  apply hxy
  apply e.symm.injective
  exact Subtype.ext (hspace (e.symm x).2 (e.symm y).2)

theorem x2611_15358_thmA :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | ∃ (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)),
      K.vertices.Finite ∧ Nat.card K.vertices = n ∧
        Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle))} 15 := by
  have H :
      (∃ C : AbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 15),
        Nonempty ({x : Fin 15 → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
          ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (C : AbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n)),
        Nonempty ({x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i) = 1 ∧
          ∃ s ∈ C.faces, ∀ i, i ∉ s → x i = 0} ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) → 14 ≤ n) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℕ) (K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex ℝ (Fin d → ℝ)),
        K.vertices.Finite → Nonempty (K.space ≃ₜ (Fin 3 → Circle)) →
          Nat.card K.vertices ≠ 14) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> sorry
  obtain ⟨hexists, hlower, hnot14⟩ := H
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hexists
    exact x2611_15358_thmA_aux7 15 (Fin 3 → Circle) C hC
  · rintro n ⟨d, K, hfin, hcard, hK⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := x2611_15358_thmA_aux8 n d (Fin 3 → Circle) K hfin hcard hK
    have hle := hlower n C hC
    have hne := hnot14 d K hfin hK
    omega
